title: The Three Garments and the Descent Into the Members
description: How the Lord enters at the deeper depth. T30 — the Living Spirit's three accommodations: he clothes himself in wind, fire, water (thought, love, natural truth) to subject the works of darkness above and below, then strips the garments off so the captive material may be purified and conveyed upward through the Zone to the Upper Place. T31 — how the Call descends through every degree of the soul: the First Man as head, the five faculties as limbs, the Living Soul as members hung from him, going forth after the soul-life that has slackened and scattered, voices sinking down into the soul to draw what was defiled back into its place — into the very image of the Father from whom it came.
